summary.intent: Run the audit-fix pipeline against UAT/verification findings to classify issues as auto-fixable vs manual-only, then autonomously fix auto-fixable findings with test verification and atomic signed commits.
summary.outcome: F-03 (BYO status wiring in StorageTab) and F-04 (MigrationProgress stale-failed-job rendering) were fixed, tested, and committed with signed commits. F-05 (migration batch timeout double-counting) was fixed and a commit was in flight at session end. F-08 (orphaned Phala secrets) was deferred as manual-only.

repo: SSH signature verification is enforced on PRs — commits must be signed; --no-gpg-sign is not an option.
Pre-commit hooks use lint-staged and take ~15s before the signing step.
1Password (op-ssh-sign) is the SSH signing agent; it must be unlocked and running or commits will hang indefinitely.
BYO advisory-quota flag is synced via PATCH /vault/byo-status; StorageTab must call this after a successful pinning-config save.
Migration module lives at apps/api/src/migration/ — processor and service both have companion spec files.
Several UAT findings (duplicate MetricsService imports, fetch binding, orphaned FUSE files) were already resolved on main before this session.

code.finding: Save flow must call vaultControllerSetByoStatus({ isByo: mode !== 'cipherbox' }) after successful pinning-config save (non-fatal on failure), before fetchQuota() picks up the updated advisory flag.
Migration batch timeout was double-counting; fix applied here and in migration.service.ts.
Co-modified with migration.processor.ts to resolve F-05 double-counting; companion spec files (migration.processor.spec.ts, migration.service.spec.ts) also updated.

workflow: When a signed commit hangs on op-ssh-sign: kill all orphaned op-ssh-sign and git commit processes, restart 1Password app, then retry — a fresh signing request triggers the authorization prompt reliably.
Sandboxed shell environments block op-ssh-sign from reaching the 1Password agent; retry commits in an unsandboxed shell.
Always run git commit from the repo root; running tests in a subdirectory (e.g., apps/api) leaves the shell cwd there and causes scoped git-add to fail.
Run targeted test suites in parallel (API jest + web package tests) before committing to keep the pipeline fast.

friction: 1Password SSH signing caused the first commit to hang indefinitely inside a sandboxed shell that blocked op-ssh-sign from reaching the agent.
Multiple commit retries were needed across three separate attempts before the signing prompt surfaced correctly.
Shell cwd was left in apps/api after running Jest, causing the F-04 commit to fail with a path error before being retried from the repo root.
Background task notifications were the only way to confirm commit success or failure, adding latency to the pipeline between fixes.
open_items: F-05 commit (migration batch timeout double-counting) was in flight at session end — confirm it landed and is signed.
F-08 (orphaned Phala secrets in GitHub staging environment) deferred as manual-only — requires manual secret rotation and environment cleanup.

Pre-existing uncommitted files (.planning/REQUIREMENTS.md, .planning/phases/18-performance-instrumentation/18-VALIDATION.md, Cargo.lock, apps/api/src/metrics/http-metrics.interceptor.spec.ts) are sitting on the branch untouched.
Branch fix/audit-f03-byo-status-wiring is local only — push and open a PR when F-05 commit is confirmed.
